english: ...So you want me to teach you the heart of a maid.\nIs that right?
I've always wanted to hear from a real maid.
(The heart of a maid... okay,\nI'll listen in secretly and master it too...)
Listen well: above all,\nthe most important thing is a caring heart!
A caring heart... right,\nwithout thinking of the other person, service is...
No! It doesn't matter WHO the other person is!
No matter who they are,\nwhat matters is how deeply you can cherish them!
Next most important is your language.\nRepeat after me!
Are you even trying to learn!?\nThat conveys no sincerity!
Ahaha, you two look so embarrassed, kyahahaa.
Well, that ran long, but that about covers it.\nWas it helpful?
I-I'm beat...\nBut... I learned a lot.
I may have underestimated\nthe maid profession...
I'm glad you understand.\nAh, I forgot one crucial thing.
Huh... did Siesta-san just look over here...
Scolding a master who's doing bad things\nis also a maid's important duty.
That's right, a naughty young lady\nneeds punishing...
Aaah! I'm gonna get punished by maids!
N-no! D-don't... tie me up with rope,\nis that a gag? *thump-thump*.
